description: Unique stable identifier for physical EV charging station
derivation_method: Canonical project station code generator (TS-{DIST}-{NUM})

description: Verified commercial or site title of the charging facility
derivation_method: Directly extracted from OCM, OSM, or TSREDCO public registry

description: Indian State administrative jurisdiction
derivation_method: Fixed administrative constant ('Telangana')

description: Harmonized Telangana district conforming to 33-district reorganization
derivation_method: Spatial boundary alignment with Census 2011/2016 structure

description: City, town, or municipal locality name
derivation_method: Directly extracted from source address/town attributes

description: WGS-84 geographic latitude coordinate
derivation_method: Direct GPS reading verified against state bounding box

description: WGS-84 geographic longitude coordinate
derivation_method: Direct GPS reading verified against state bounding box

description: Six-digit Indian Postal Index Number
derivation_method: Directly extracted from address metadata where available
notes: Available for 13 baseline stations; unrecorded in pure GPS nodes

description: Functional classification of the host physical venue
derivation_method: Classified from host premises (public_transit_hub, government_office)

description: Standardized charging speed and electrical power category
derivation_method: Harmonized to DC_FAST (>=50kW), AC_LEVEL2 (7-22kW), AC_LEVEL1
notes: 131 DC Fast, 22 AC L2, 1 AC L1, 12 NA

description: Physical plug and socket standard installed
derivation_method: Standardized naming: CCS (Type 2), Type 2, Type 1

description: Number of active charging dispensing guns or bays
derivation_method: Reported physical dispenser count

description: Rated maximum output power per charging dispenser
derivation_method: Directly reported equipment specification

description: Total commissioned nameplate power capacity of the station
derivation_method: Directly reported aggregate facility capacity from utility sanction

description: Operational readiness status of the charging facility
derivation_method: Verified active operating status

description: Commercial Charge Point Operator (CPO) or public agency
derivation_method: Directly extracted from registry operator metadata
notes: TGREDCO, REIL, EESL, NTPC, private CPOs; 12 NA

description: Indicator of whether facility is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
derivation_method: Verified against FAME-II public network mandate; NA for unrecorded baseline

description: OpenStreetMap functional road hierarchy classification
derivation_method: Nearest OSM highway way segment tag

description: Official reference of nearest National Highway corridor
derivation_method: Spatial proximity match against official 6 NH corridor alignments

description: Shortest distance from station to nearest National Highway centerline
derivation_method: Great-circle distance to nearest OSM highway vertex
notes: Median: 0.79 km, Min: 0.00 km, Max: 23.15 km

description: Distance to district administrative headquarters centroid
derivation_method: Great-circle distance to verified district HQ coordinates

description: Measured vehicle traffic volume or AADT along adjacent road
derivation_method: Strictly NOT derived; kept as NA per anti-fabrication mandate
notes: Preserved as NA; no open sensor feed available

description: Count of commercial, transit, and service POIs within 1,000m buffer
derivation_method: OSM Overpass spatial query within 1km radius

description: Presence of designated vehicular parking bays at the facility
derivation_method: Verified dedicated EV parking bays from transit/depot site plans

description: ISO 8601 timestamp of data collection or verification snapshot
derivation_method: Preserved timestamp from collection pipeline
